about: C3b after the critic, tail_close: the critic's 'close' - in the streets (phase a) flat out at his car, onto his bumper and into it ('closer' in src/scenes/tail/bot.js). He answers by flooring it (his foot stays down while I am on him), my nose cannot hold his bumper, a graze never turns him, I never get past; and he is never left wedged on a column (vehicles/pilot.js: backs out and round it, the other side the next try).
